description:
Measure and report the cargo-ci suite clock and the per-test profile after the test-topology changes.

## Background

Before this work, under the build turnstile, the warm `cargo-ci` suite clock was about 21.1 s (16.7 s test plus 4.4 s doctest; latest warm run `8e22dd96` at `0896fc29b`), and 24-29.6 s after a rebuild. The slowest tests were `server_integration` `graceful_shutdown…force_closes` (5.32 s), the cargo-ci self-test wrapper (3.99 s) and two `profile_cli_tests` (3.66 s), and the doctest substep took 4.4 s. `scripts/profile-test-suite.sh` produces per-test timings.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Under the build turnstile on a quiet host, the `cargo-ci` suite clock is measured on a warm target and after a rebuild, and reported beside the figures before.
- [hard] REQ-02: A per-test profile of the default suite on a warm target at load ≤ 10 shows no test over 5 s and a doctest substep under 5 s, and the note records it.
- [hard] REQ-03: Each figure names its commit, host load and command.
title: Suite clock before and after the epic is reported
